💡 This work first links plating-induced stress heterogeneity to Zn dendrite initiation via chemical-potential gradients. It offers a stress-regulation strategy for dendrite-free metal anodes.

item.title: Temperature-stable high-κ oxides for miniaturized capacitors
item.description:
این پژوهش اکسیدهای high-κ پایدار در دما را برای خازن‌های مینیاتوری معرفی می‌کند که عملکرد الکتریکی را در دماهای بالا حفظ می‌کنند.
Nature Electronics | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Machine learning-guided design identified tungsten bronze oxides with Bi/Ge co-substitution, yielding a ceramic with high permittivity (~185), ultra-low loss (<0.0005), and near-zero temperature coefficient (≤±30 ppm/°C). Strong Ge–O bonds sustain polar displacements during thermal expansion. Prototype capacitors exceed commercial benchmarks, demonstrating how ML can navigate vast compositional spaces to discover temperature-stable, low-loss, high-κ dielectrics for miniaturized electronics.
🏷 high-κ oxides · capacitors · temperature stability · miniaturization · dielectrics
